pr_title: Fix test for Windows line endings
pr_body:
Adjustments to the MockTerminal class in #86198 and elsewhere have broken tests that depended on specific line endings. In many cases, this was not what the test was actually trying to check for. This fix makes the strings as system-agnostic as possible, in several cases using the `String#lines` method to handle line endings in a system-agnostic way.

Closes #86294. Closes #86341
